_comment: Gated set for the auth-coverage drift detector (scripts/auth_coverage_drift.py). Rule 70B: data lives here, not in the script. Each repo was confirmed LIVE on its default branch (2026-09-11) to carry the named reporter for expected_context. reporter_workflow is the file the context was found in at seed time (informational — the detector scans ALL workflows, so a benign rename of this file does not false-alarm as long as the job still reports the context). To enroll a repo: confirm its reporter live, then add a row here.

not_enrolled.reason: No auth-coverage reporter on its default branch (ci.yml reports typecheck/shellcheck/taxo-guard/jest, no auth job) AND RequiredStatusChecks is null on sandbox (verified 2026-09-11). It is not drift (never enrolled) — it is an enrollment decision for the chat lane. Left out of the gated set so the detector does not report a repo nobody has decided should be gated. Add it here once a reporter is wired.
